data.name: Sala Manager
data.detailed_description:
Futsal is a game of suffocating pressure, split-second decisions, and explosive technical skill. As the manager,you are solving a hyper-dynamic positional puzzle where every square inch of the court matters, and a single player rotation determines your survival.

Build your club, master the indoor economy, and outsmart your rivals in a punishingly addictive management loop.

⚡ Fast-Paced Tactical Mastery (No Football Knowledge Required)

Standard football logic won't save you here. Designed with clean, accessible visual UI and deep strategic depth. Deploy aggressive flying goalkeepers, and master fluid 4-0 or 3-1 rotations. Real-time match simulations demand instant, snap adaptations to counter your opponent's high press.

🏢 Build a High-Speed Tycoon Empire

Take a grassroots club from local sports halls to the grand stages of continental glory. Balance the books, navigate cutthroat sponsorship deals, and expand your club's infrastructure. Non-fans and tycoon lovers will find deep satisfaction in upgrading specialized training facilities, managing staff pipelines, and building a sustainable sports powerhouse from the ground up.

🃏 Draft, Synergize, and Develop Your Squad

Manage individual player egos, fitness levels, and youth academy prospects to build your perfect engine.

🛠️ Key Features

  • The "One More Match" Loop: Snappy menus, lightning-fast loading times, and short matches ensure an addictive, uninterrupted gameplay flow.

  • Dynamic Match Engine: Experience intense 5v5 action driven by realistic ball physics tailored for the heavier, low-bounce futsal ball.

The court is small. The pace is relentless. The stakes are massive. Do you have the vision to dominate the hardwood?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core 2 Duo 2.0 GHz or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: GPU with OpenGL 3.0 or Vulkan support (Intel HD 4000)
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated or integrated GPU with recent driver updates
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
